source.source_text: Purpose: return local/remote branch metadata without checkout, switch or fetch. Input: project_root:string, include_remote?:boolean. Output: branches, current branch, upstream/ahead/behind if locally known. Contract: L2 read_only; scope mac.git.read; target project_root; timeout 10000ms; cap 256KiB; network none; filesystem read_allowed_project; secrets redacted; approval trusted_read; idempotent yes. Phase 3 planned.
